lessons: Release a confirmed hold through the one admission entry, MergeQueue.admit() or admit_delivery with releasing=True. Never take queue._slot or call queue._admit directly: that skips admission_hold.wait() and the rework handoff.

A release that gate-fails or needs rework against moved main must retire the hold durably (discard_hold, released=True) and go through the normal non-ok terminal/harvest path. Never raise RuntimeError and leave the stem held.
Add a test where moved main makes the release gate-fail or conflict. Assert the hold is retired, the terminal and harvest are written, and the stem is dispatchable again.

Call compose_pipeline directly in tests. Never build a callee name from strings to get past a caller-inventory check. If the inventory rejects the call, update it inside the fence or file a separate ticket.

No dual-path code: always unpack admit_delivery's 4-tuple and update every double that returns 3 values. Call pipeline.confirm_hold directly, with no getattr fallback. Pass effect_identity the same way on every path.
The HELD boundary, restart projection, drain exclusion, and confirm CLI passed review. Keep them and fix only the release path and the test honesty issues.
reason: Review snag on fixable defects (release bypasses the one admission entry, failed release strands the hold, a test built to dodge a gate, compat branches). The design otherwise holds, so the same capability can fix it.
